title: Import Text Items
intro: Upload a CSV file to add many Text Items at once. Every row is validated the same way as the regular form; if one row fails, nothing is saved.
templateHint: The template has the column headers and one example row with subsubcategoryId "0" -- replace that example row with your own rows before uploading the file.

errors.header: The column headers do not match the template.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has too many rows (maximum 500).
errors.parseError: The file could not be read as CSV.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (maximum 1 MB).
